turns.text: Hi! Thanks for staying today. Let me tell you how we close the café.
turns.style: kind café manager, a little tired at the end of the day. American English accent. Slow, clear and natural pace for A2 English learners, with a short pause between sentences.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Sure. What do I need to do?

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: First, wash the cups. Then clean the tables and put the chairs on them. At nine, turn off the coffee machine.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Sorry, what do I do with the chairs?
turns.style: new worker, careful and polite. American English accent. Slow, clear and natural pace for A2 English learners, with a short pause between sentences.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Put them on the tables, so we can clean the floor.
turns.style: kind café manager, a little tired at the end of the day. American English accent. Slow, clear and natural pace for A2 English learners, with a short pause between sentences.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: OK. And why at nine for the machine?
turns.style: new worker, careful and polite. American English accent. Slow, clear and natural pace for A2 English learners, with a short pause between sentences.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Because some people come late for a coffee.
turns.style: kind café manager, a little tired at the end of the day. American English accent. Slow, clear and natural pace for A2 English learners, with a short pause between sentences.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: That makes sense. So, the cups first, then the tables and chairs, and the machine at nine.
turns.style: new worker, careful and polite. American English accent. Slow, clear and natural pace for A2 English learners, with a short pause between sentences.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Perfect. Let me know if you have a question.
